name: Anarchy Road
detailed_description:
Speed through sprawling, perilous landscapes, armed to the teeth with an arsenal of powerful weapons and game-changing power-ups including supercharged jumps and adrenaline-pumping nitro boosts. The story unfolds as you master various cars, each with its own set of unique abilities, propelling you through epic war zones. But beware — relentless machines, towering robots, and hostile vehicles will hunt you down at every turn, determined to halt your advance and bring your mission to a screeching halt! 

The cast of characters in Anarchy Road are ready to make every turn exciting and action packed.

Rondo is everyone's cool older brother. He is always ready to defend his friends and, in this case, his homeland. He really desires to live a peaceful life where he can spend his time working on classic cars.

He drives The Metal Aggressor, it is armed with two high-powered guns, and boasts an explosive turbo boost, with power shields for those tough moments.

A survivalist since childhood, Fae looks forward to the day when she can leave this town behind and explore the outside world. This journey will allow her to do that and will be a welcome change of scenery.

Her car is called the President, its special capabilities are still top-secret so stay tuned!

This is Latchkey, he is one of the characters you'll play as in Anarchy Road. His car, "The Tarantula" is fast, nimble, and features a mounted gun, an air missile system, as well as shields and a jump booster in order to clear dangerous traps and obstacles.

More than anything, Latchkey wants to put The Tarantula to the test in battle and show what it can do!

Meet Jawline — a century-old cyborg with a rusty mind and a thirst for one last road trip down Anarchy Road.

He drives The Rhino — a massive, armored beast built for speed, ramming, and unloading heavy firepower. Stay tuned for the Rhino's special abilities!

The story of Anarchy is told through a comic book presentation that allows the player to take on the journey as each of the 4 playable characters. Like many great comic books, there are many cliff-hangers and moments that have to be seen to be believed.

There is no shortage of action and insane moments such as driving through burning and collapsing cities, taking on monolithic robots, and pursuing marauding motorcycle gangs. Do you have what it takes to survive the Anarchy Road? Demo coming soon!

Be among the first to play the upcoming free demo where the player must escape a city that is under attack!

Are you up to the challenge?

short_description: Fast Speeds, Big Explosions, even Bigger Bosses and action throughout! Anarchy Road is a Post-Apocalyptic action driving game where our 4 heroes must race against the clock, battle bosses, while blasting enemies and dodging traps in order to survive to the explosive end!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or Newer (64 bit) Windows OS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1300x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4GB / GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon R7 370 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or Newer (64 bit) Windows OS
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080 / AMD Radeon 5700X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
